In spite of repeated opportunity (three times-one u  and third by Court), the petitioner(s)/ applicant(s)/appellan  objection/default.

As a result, by way of indulgence and last  SIX WEEKS' further time is granted to the petitioner(s)/appli  matters to remove office objection/default and make the matte  that time, failing which the concerned petition/application/a  prosecution without further reference to the Court.

Provided, however, in cases, where the objection/de  of the respondent, on expiry of the extended period, the conc dismissed for non-prosecution only against the unserved respondent(s), without further reference to the Court.
The matter would then proceed against the remaining respondent(s).

In cases where the office objection/default has already been cured before passing of this order, it will be open to the concerned party to bring that fact to the notice of the Registrar (Judicial-II), who may examine the same and proceed with the matter as per the listing /scheme, if ready for hearing.
If the office objections are removed within the time extended in terms of this order, the concerned matter(s) be made returnable on the date notified hereafter.
